articulation.label: one
articulation.alt: one: /w/ → /ʌ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: two
articulation.alt: two: /t/ → /u/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: said
articulation.alt: said: /s/ → /ɛ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: the
articulation.alt: the: /ð/ → /ə/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ð/: Tongue tip at the teeth; add voice.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
